name: Tide Studio
text: Road shoes designed with a panel of forty runners. Light uppers, rocker geometry and foam tuned for easy and steady miles.

name: Yard Supply
text: Low, stable and hard-wearing. Reinforced toes, grippy rubber and uppers that shrug off chalk, mud and rope climbs.

name: Hollis Form
text: Leather, suede and canvas on cupsoles and vulcanized soles. Classic proportions, built to be worn every day and resoled.
